description: A dermatologist-inspired skincare routine tailored for the summer season, focusing on protection from UV rays and keeping skin hydrated.
frequency: daily for morning and night steps; weekly for exfoliation and mask treatments

morning_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare the skin for treatment.
recommended_ingredients: Soothing ingredients like chamomile or aloe vera

morning_steps.purpose: Hydrate the skin and lock in moisture for the day.

night_steps.purpose: Remove dirt, sweat, and makeup without stripping the skin.
recommended_ingredients: Soothing ingredients like chamomile or aloe vera

night_steps.purpose: Replenish moisture and support the skin's natural barrier.
recommended_ingredients: Antioxidants like vitamin C or E

dont: Avoid over-exfoliating, which can irritate the skin and make it more sensitive to UV rays.
Do not use heavy products during summer as they may clog pores and cause breakouts.
common_mistakes: Not reapplying sunscreen every two hours when outdoors

expected_results.2_weeks: Skin should feel more hydrated and have a smoother texture.
expected_results.1_month: Significant improvement in skin hydration and reduced appearance of fine lines.
expected_results.3_months: Improved skin barrier function, fewer breakouts, and overall healthier-looking skin.

expert_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water daily to support your skin's moisture levels from the inside out.
Protect your skin from UV rays using a combination of physical barriers like hats and sunglasses, as well as chemical sunscreens.
